historical.text: Major hill fort in the Sahyadri range, developed by Shivaji and described as his principal seat from the mid-1650s. Dates of construction phases vary by source.
sources: Mehendale, Gajanan B. Shivaji: His Life and Times

pratapgad.name: Pratapgad

historical.text: Fort near Mahabaleshwar built in the mid-to-late 1650s. Tradition places the November 1659 events with Afzal Khan nearby.
sources: Sarkar, Jadunath. Shivaji and His Times

pratapgad.gameplay_note: Walls start at 80: still being completed (gameplay representation).

historical.text: Major hill fort south-east of Pune, traditionally in Maratha hands from about 1648. Later history falls outside this scenario.
sources: Sarkar, Jadunath. Shivaji and His Times

historical.text: Large hill fort near Kolhapur. Traditional accounts say Shivaji took it in late 1659; Siddi Jauhar's siege of 1660 followed. Dates and details are disputed.
sources: Sarkar, Jadunath. Shivaji and His Times
